Check evidence for imported-stone and lighting assumptions in Xinyi quote v3

Validate the imported-stone and lighting assumptions using the linked historical evidence.

Imported-stone forecast direct cost differs by +18.4% from eligible reconciled-actual history.

Lighting quoted price differs by +9.4% from eligible quoted-price history.

Lighting reconciled-actual evidence is insufficient: 2 of 3 required observations. No supported actual-cost range is available.

The programme is 16 weeks versus 19.00–22.00 weeks in the selected history. No evidence supports a quantified programme premium.

Comparison: cmprun_ea38cf86-e601-4885-97cb-784373dd8762; economics enrichment: econrun_38c286f1-213c-4ac5-b365-5e38e5619a9b.

This creates an internal review item. It does not approve or issue the quotation, authorize commercial commitments, or contact anyone externally.

Historical comparisons do not establish that this quotation is wrong, a supplier is overcharging, or an accelerated programme caused a specific premium. Supplier prices are not confirmed as currently valid.
